subject: Harbor Analytics — banking proof, ACH remit format, and first-remit acknowledgement
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@harboranalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: treasury@harboranalytics.com
Date: Thu, 08 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Harbor banking proof + remit mapping (W9 & bank letter attached)

Hi Ben —

Attached are the requested documents to complete vendor onboarding:
- Signed bank letter (Harbor_BankLetter_signed.pdf) — includes routing and account ending digits.
- W9 (Harbor_W9_2028.pdf).
- Small CSV sample of the remittance fields we send on our side (remit_sample.csv).

Quick notes on the remittance: our ERP (HarborPay) puts a structured remittance line that looks like: INV|PO-12345|AMT:1200.00|ITEMS:3
We can also include your PO number in the line-item metadata if Redwood needs a different mapping — tell us the PO field name and we’ll ensure it’s present.

Would you like us to send a test ACH this week or wait until your first live payment? Either works for us — we can coordinate a small $1 micro-deposit if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Accounting Manager
Harbor Analytics
elena.morales@harboranalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Harbor_W9_2028.pdf (application/pdf), Harbor_BankLetter_signed.pdf (application/pdf), remit_sample.csv (text/csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harbor banking proof + remit mapping (W9 & bank letter attached)

Elena —

Got everything, thank you. I uploaded the bank letter and W9 to Finance for verification. A couple quick clarifying asks so we can wire this into our PO flow:

1) PO number placement: Redwood's payops system expects the PO to appear either as PO_NUMBER or in the remittance line as PO-xxxxx. Your sample looks good; can you add a second example row with the invoice number and PO separated into two columns? The CSV you sent has a single remittance cell — we prefer a PO column if possible.

2) Micro-deposit: yes please — a $0.50 test ACH from Harbor would speed verification. Please send to the account details in the bank letter and mark the transaction description as "RDWD TEST" so we can match it.

Kimberly (cc) will take this over for funds validation and to schedule the first payment run once micro-deposit reconciles. Marissa, FYI for the PO mapping to the merchant profile.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: none

Hi all —

Finance completed verification this afternoon. Bank letter and W9 match our vendor intake rules; micro-deposit with trace id TRX-778203 posted at 15:12 PST (amount $0.50) to account ending 4219 and description matched "RDWD TEST".

Next steps:
- We will schedule Harbor for Redwood's next pay run on Monday 2028-03-13. Please confirm if you want net-7 or net-30 payment terms applied to initial invoices — default is net-30.
- For remittance mapping, we accepted the updated CSV layout. Our AP system will read the PO_NUMBER column and match to PO- references in invoices. If you can add a header row example in the CSV showing "PO_NUMBER,INVOICE_NUMBER,AMOUNT,REMIT_LINE" that would be ideal.

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Marissa, please create the vendor profile with PO mapping tag "harbor_po" and set payment terms to net-30 unless Elena confirms otherwise.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
